Annotated release tag verifies against the approved SSH signer allow-list.
The successful v1.2.6 workflow exclusively built, reproduced, hashed, attested, and uploaded release artifacts.
Builder has contents:read, id-token:write, attestations:write and no secrets or publish authority.
v1.2.6 publisher verified checksums and provenance, did not rebuild, and matched PyPI hashes.
The v1.2.6 CycloneDX document is attached to the release and its SBOM attestation is bound to the wheel.
Signed release v1.2.6 successfully traversed the reusable builder and exact-byte publisher.
Public wheel and sdist independently verified against the expected reusable signer workflow on 2026-08-31.
The assessed v1.2.6 wheel and sdist satisfy the SLSA v1.2 Build L3 producer, provenance, hosted, and isolated-builder requirements.
